source: Frame-by-frame rendering of actual recorded API session outcomes, through the unchanged game client. Original outcome transcript retained; no outcome fabrication or optical-flow interpolation. Animation time advances exactly 1/60 s per output frame; browser timer ticks rounded to the nearest millisecond.
editing: Chronological highlights; straight cuts near music beats; no editorial text, descriptions, end cards, SVG or gameplay audio. Native game UI remains.
encoding: Single continuous H.264 High stream; 60 FPS, 1-second GOP, faststart. No stream-copy splice of independently encoded shots.
